Read AGENTS.md and docs first. Own only the agreed src modules and focused tests. Keep simulation independent of Three.js. Define interfaces before implementation; support both existing games. Make lifecycle and deterministic generation testable. Do not add genre-specific rules to the engine. Report changed files, checks and unresolved issues. Do not merge or deploy.
